observations: WP-12dm / WP-S2c-76 is the H-003 combined R1+R2 cycle 2 evidence package. It uses existing committed EXP-0004 and creates REP-0029, one trial-log row, OL-0029, and two separate RECs from OL-0029 for d2_006_gates and exp_success_criteria.
